shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Applied to project and skill cards on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main calls to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #56A8F5; color: #fff; padding: 13px 24px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4B93D6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #DFE1E5; border: 1px solid #43454A; padding: 13px 24px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #A9B0B7; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Used for cards and containers to create depth.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background: #2B2D30; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-glass-panel:hover { border-color: #56A8F5; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: Professional, crisp, and highly technical. The UI stays out of the way of the content and embraces a native IDE-inspired aesthetic. It relies on clean lines, a dark, coding-centric palette, and a structured layout to present native Android development skills.

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: The UI should never overshadow the work. Use accent colors sparingly to draw attention to interactive elements, not to decorate the page.

rules.name: The Mono Metadata Rule
rules.body: All metadata, tags, headings and technical details should use the monospace font to reinforce the developer aesthetic.

rules.name: The Interactive Lift Rule
rules.body: Cards and interactive containers should lift subtly on hover, signaling clickability without overwhelming the user.

dos: Do use glass-panel for primary content containers to create depth.
Do use JetBrains Mono for technical terms, dates, headings, and metadata.
donts: Don't overuse the IDE Orange accent color; keep it reserved for active states or warnings.
Don't use solid drop shadows on resting elements.
